title.zh: 美股，正在进入币圈 App
title.en: US Stocks Are Entering Crypto Apps

zh.text: 不只是看涨跌、做模拟，而是开始连接真实的美股与 ETF 资产、分红和公司行动。随着稳定币美股方案陆续出现，用 USDT / USDC 参与全球优质资产，正变得更直接。
相比传统跨境入金流程，这类方式也可能减少资金划转、开户与兑换环节的摩擦；但平台准入、资产归属、税务申报和当地合规要求，仍需在参与前确认清楚。
想了解如何开始？先选择可信的大平台，确认自己能够访问、注册，并真正理解交易规则。

en.text: This is no longer just about watching prices or paper trading. Crypto apps are beginning to connect users with real US stocks and ETFs, including dividends and corporate actions. As stablecoin-based US stock offerings emerge, accessing global assets with USDT or USDC is becoming more direct.

Compared with traditional cross-border funding, this may reduce friction around transfers, account setup, and currency conversion. Platform access, asset ownership, tax reporting, and local compliance requirements still need to be understood before participating.
Want to learn how to get started? Choose a reputable platform first, make sure you can access and register for it, and understand its rules.
